{{Quote|They're the workhorses of this outfit, I can tell you that.|Tiree, referring to the BTL Y-wing starfighter|<ref name="SWG">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
'''Tiree''' was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he flew in [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] as [[Gold Two/Legends|Gold Two]] on [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon Vander's]] wing in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], where he was the first of his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmates]] to be shot down by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Computer's locked. Getting a signal. The guns... they've stopped!|Tiree|<ref name="ANH" />}}
A young [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]], Tiree was well noted for participating in a [[Raid on Corellia|raid]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where, flying a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] as [[Gold Two/Legends|Gold Two]], he helped save [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] who proved invaluable to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].<ref name="JKTCG">{{JKTCG|set=Premiere|cardname=Gold Two|link=http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/cardlists/premier/large/151ugoldtwo.html}}</ref>

Later in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Tiree flew with the Alliance's [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]], once again using the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] Gold Two, and [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] a Y-wing with custom high-power lateral thrusters, allowing the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] to better draw and evade enemy fire.<ref name="CCGG2">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Gold 2}}</ref>

Tiree flew alongside [[Gold Five/Legends|Gold Five]] [[Davish Krail/Legends|Davish "Pops" Krail]], providing defensive cover to [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon "Dutch" Vander]] in the Rebels' first trench run on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Tiree followed Vander's order to transfer all power to his Y-wing's front [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector screen]] as a defense against the space station's [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] turrets, which Tiree described as "a little aggressive".<ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> Locking his [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] and receiving a signal for the coming attack on the Death Star's [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]], Tiree observed that the turbolasers had suddenly ceased firing, as three [[TIE series/Legends|enemy fighters]], lead by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], entered the trench. Tiree was quickly shot down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] when [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|Darth Vader's TIE Advanced x1]] struck his Y-wings's [[Engine/Legends|engines]], causing an electrical explosion in the cockpit before his fighter was engulfed in flame. Remembered by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] as a good man,<ref name="CTE">''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]''</ref> Tiree was joined shortly by his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmates]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tiree was played by [[Jeremy Sinden]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].

Although Gold Five identifies his wingmate as Tiree in ''A New Hope'', it is unclear whether the name refers to Gold Two or Gold Leader.<ref name="ANH" /> The pilot known as Gold Two was first connected to the name Tiree in [[1984]]'s ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''.<ref name="AGTTSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

The [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of ''A New Hope'' identifies Tiree's [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] as Red Squadron, and Tiree as [[Red Two/Legends|Red Two]].<ref name="ANHn" />

Tiree's helmet prop was later worn by [[Habeer Zignean]] in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="SWI 55">{{InsiderCite|55|Set Piece|Set Piece: Hoth Echo Base Main Hangar}}</ref>
